### Issues: the same problem on the same compactor, counted once
Pick a **customer**, **waste company** or **problem** at the top. **Times seen** = on how many lifts or invoice lines it happened. **Found by**: *AI model* (our live lift model) or *rules*.
The lower table lists every single record. It is a **difference to check, not an accusation** — the cause can also be a sensor or missing data.

panels.title: How many issues of each problem?

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE label_family WHEN 'COST_PER_T_HIGH' THEN 'Very high cost per tonne' WHEN 'PREMATURE_UNJUSTIFIED' THEN 'Emptied too early' WHEN 'DELAYED_COLLECTION' THEN 'Emptied too late (overflow risk)' WHEN 'WEIGHT_DISCREPANCY' THEN 'Our scale and truck scale disagree' WHEN 'CONTAMINATION_VALUE_LOSS' THEN 'Dirty load lost its value' WHEN 'REJECTED_LOAD' THEN 'Load rejected' WHEN 'OUTDATED_TARIFF' THEN 'Old price on invoice' WHEN 'DUPLICATE_LINE' THEN 'Charged twice' WHEN 'WRONG_SURCHARGE' THEN 'Wrong extra fee' WHEN 'WEIGHT_BASIS_MISMATCH' THEN 'Invoice tonnes differ from truck scale' WHEN 'UNMATCHED_LINE' THEN 'Charge without a lift' WHEN 'MISSING_LINE' THEN 'Charge or credit missing' WHEN 'UNINVOICED_COLLECTION' THEN 'Lift never invoiced' ELSE label_family END AS "Problem", count(*) AS "Issues" FROM cp_issues WHERE customer_name IN ($customer) AND operator_name IN ($operator) AND label_family IN ($problem) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT customer_name AS "Customer", site_name AS "Site", CASE label_family WHEN 'COST_PER_T_HIGH' THEN 'Very high cost per tonne' WHEN 'PREMATURE_UNJUSTIFIED' THEN 'Emptied too early' WHEN 'DELAYED_COLLECTION' THEN 'Emptied too late (overflow risk)' WHEN 'WEIGHT_DISCREPANCY' THEN 'Our scale and truck scale disagree' WHEN 'CONTAMINATION_VALUE_LOSS' THEN 'Dirty load lost its value' WHEN 'REJECTED_LOAD' THEN 'Load rejected' WHEN 'OUTDATED_TARIFF' THEN 'Old price on invoice' WHEN 'DUPLICATE_LINE' THEN 'Charged twice' WHEN 'WRONG_SURCHARGE' THEN 'Wrong extra fee' WHEN 'WEIGHT_BASIS_MISMATCH' THEN 'Invoice tonnes differ from truck scale' WHEN 'UNMATCHED_LINE' THEN 'Charge without a lift' WHEN 'MISSING_LINE' THEN 'Charge or credit missing' WHEN 'UNINVOICED_COLLECTION' THEN 'Lift never invoiced' ELSE label_family END AS "Problem", times_seen AS "Times seen", to_char(last_seen, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Last seen", eur_at_stake AS "Euros", CASE detected_by WHEN 'live lift model' THEN 'AI model' ELSE 'rules' END AS "Found by" FROM cp_issues WHERE customer_name IN ($customer) AND operator_name IN ($operator) AND label_family IN ($problem) ORDER BY eur_at_stake DESC, times_seen DESC LIMIT 1000

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(found_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Date", customer_name AS "Customer", CASE label_family WHEN 'COST_PER_T_HIGH' THEN 'Very high cost per tonne' WHEN 'PREMATURE_UNJUSTIFIED' THEN 'Emptied too early' WHEN 'DELAYED_COLLECTION' THEN 'Emptied too late (overflow risk)' WHEN 'WEIGHT_DISCREPANCY' THEN 'Our scale and truck scale disagree' WHEN 'CONTAMINATION_VALUE_LOSS' THEN 'Dirty load lost its value' WHEN 'REJECTED_LOAD' THEN 'Load rejected' WHEN 'OUTDATED_TARIFF' THEN 'Old price on invoice' WHEN 'DUPLICATE_LINE' THEN 'Charged twice' WHEN 'WRONG_SURCHARGE' THEN 'Wrong extra fee' WHEN 'WEIGHT_BASIS_MISMATCH' THEN 'Invoice tonnes differ from truck scale' WHEN 'UNMATCHED_LINE' THEN 'Charge without a lift' WHEN 'MISSING_LINE' THEN 'Charge or credit missing' WHEN 'UNINVOICED_COLLECTION' THEN 'Lift never invoiced' ELSE label_family END AS "Problem", evidence AS "What the data shows", eur_at_stake AS "Euros", entity_id AS "Record" FROM cp_flags WHERE customer_name IN ($customer) AND operator_name IN ($operator) AND label_family IN ($problem) AND $__timeFilter(found_at) ORDER BY eur_at_stake DESC NULLS LAST, found_at DESC LIMIT 1000
